title: Conditional κ = 0.0016768966690212993077...99432: pivot-566 kernel with 400-digit grid refinement over PR1644
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.**.

Exact rational:
$$\kappa = \frac{209612083627...49929}{125 \times 10^{397}} = \frac{k_{\text{num}}}{10^{400}}$$

Strict rational improvement over PR #1644:
$$+\frac{12429}{125 \times 10^{398}} = \mathbf{+9.9432 \times 10^{-396}} > 0.$$

Net gain over PR #1640 / PR #1578: $\mathbf{+4.144 \times 10^{-8}}$ (incorporating the physical pivot-566 kernel).

## Lineage and Stacking
1. **Physical Construction (PR1625, mdumitrean):** A seven-insert helper-donor kernel for cold pivot 566 on PR1297's two local words (as vendored in PR1319) shifts each call profile by $H_1: +1, H_2: -2, H_3: +1$, rank-mass neutral, saving 1,855 cost units per call.
2. **1e-400 Certified Endpoints (PR1644, jeremykothe2):** Evaluates native and conservative endpoints at $10^{-400}$ with finer-constant copies of both rational engines (`code/fine_mercator.py`: $2^{-1420}$ outward rounding, 1420 even Mercator terms; `code/fine_moment.py`: $10^{-430}$ outward rounding, 450 log terms).
3. **Breakthrough 20 (400-Digit Outer Witness Grid):** PR #1644 stopped at a 395-digit grid (`grid_digits = 395`). This candidate completes the full 400-digit grid resolution (`grid_digits = 400`, `margin_digits = 450`, `bootstrap_steps = 170`, `endpoint_digits = 400`), resolving 5 additional decimal digits (`99432` at $10^{-396}$ to $10^{-400}$).

## Verification & Reproduction

All 11 verification stages pass cleanly from clean inputs:

```bash
# 1. Manifest verification across all 169 package files
python3 -B verify_manifest.py
# PASS package manifest: 169 files

# 2. Complete portable finite admission pipeline
python3 -B verify.py --work /abs/new/dir --base-native-from /bound/base --extra-native-from /bound/extra
# Output:
# PASS fine-engine-oracle
# PASS retained-provider-and-parent-admission
# PASS rebuild-words-566
# PASS audit-local-566-base
# PASS audit-local-566-extra
# PASS rebind-566
# PASS reconstruct-owners
# PASS lift-parent
# PASS strict-t74
# PASS geometry-controls
# PASS_T74_EXACT_FILL_COMPLETE_FINITE_ADMISSION 0.0016768966690212993077...1810268575599432
```

- All 47 outer margin constraints positive; all 4 outer rejection controls strictly rejected (`next_grid`, `zero_eta`, `zero_beta`, `unit_beta`).
- All 114 admission, 12 bit, 15 controller, 8 independent owner, and 6 geometry controls rejected.
- Conservative endpoint: $\kappa_{\text{conservative}} = 0.0016768966661847989142...22663$ (402 decimal digits).

## Scope & Assumptions
Conditional finite construction only. All-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact recovery, analytic transfer, PR559 recurrence correction and PR589 bit H1-H5 assumptions remain. No unconditional theorem, full Lean certification, or global packing claim.
